Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

I. Scope — Dimensional and other requirements of pelvic band for steel orthopaedic calipers and braces. 
2« Terminology 

2J Pdfic Aond — Used to control rotation of the extremit/t to limit movement and to provide 
stability. The band must grip the pelvis firmly.

FIG. I PELVIC BAND FOR STEEL ORTHOPAEDIC CALIPERS AND BRACES 

4. Material — Mild steel sheet, cold rolled or aluminium alloy conforming to Designation 24345 of 
IS : 737-1974 * Specification for wrought aluminium and aluminium alloys, sheet and strip ( for general 
engineering purposes ) ( second revision ) *. 

5» Worlcmanship and Finish — The band shall be cut to size shown in Fig. t. it shall be reasonably 
flat and the surfaces shall be free from defects. The cut edges shall be rounded by grinding or filing. 
The final bending of the band shall be done to suit the requirements of the individual at the time of 
fitting the brace. 

6. Marking — Each band shall be marked with the following 

a) Manufacturer's name, Initials or recognized trade-mark, and 

b) Size of the band. 

6.1 ISI Ctnificoilon Mork/ng — Details available from the Indian Standards Institution. New Delhi I. 

7. Packing-- As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
